help.short: The name of the lab that uniquely identifies it within containing lab account. Used in resource URIs.

description: Get the properties of a lab resource.

operations.description: Returns the properties of a lab resource.

params.description: The name of the lab that uniquely identifies it within containing lab account. Used in resource URIs.
params.name: labName

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: The geo-location where the resource lives
props.name: location

props.description: The name of the resource
props.name: name

props.description: Lab resource properties
props.name: properties

props.description: The resource auto shutdown configuration for the lab. This controls whether actions are taken on resources that are sitting idle.
props.name: autoShutdownProfile

props.description: The amount of time a VM will stay running after a user disconnects if this behavior is enabled.
props.name: disconnectDelay

props.description: The amount of time a VM will idle before it is shutdown if this behavior is enabled.
props.name: idleDelay

props.description: The amount of time a VM will stay running before it is shutdown if no connection is made and this behavior is enabled.
props.name: noConnectDelay

props.description: Whether shutdown on disconnect is enabled
props.name: shutdownOnDisconnect

props.description: Whether a VM will get shutdown when it has idled for a period of time.
props.name: shutdownOnIdle

props.description: Whether a VM will get shutdown when it hasn't been connected to after a period of time.
props.name: shutdownWhenNotConnected

props.description: The connection profile for the lab. This controls settings such as web access to lab resources or whether RDP or SSH ports are open.
props.name: connectionProfile

props.description: The enabled access level for Client Access over RDP.
props.name: clientRdpAccess

props.description: The enabled access level for Client Access over SSH.
props.name: clientSshAccess

props.description: The enabled access level for Web Access over RDP.
props.name: webRdpAccess

props.description: The enabled access level for Web Access over SSH.
props.name: webSshAccess

props.description: The description of the lab.
props.name: description

props.description: The ID of the lab plan. Used during resource creation to provide defaults and acts as a permission container when creating a lab via labs.azure.com. Setting a labPlanId on an existing lab provides organization..
props.name: labPlanId

props.description: The network profile for the lab, typically applied via a lab plan. This profile cannot be modified once a lab has been created.
props.name: networkProfile

props.description: The external load balancer resource id
props.name: loadBalancerId

props.description: The external public IP resource id
props.name: publicIpId

props.description: The external subnet resource id
props.name: subnetId

props.description: Current provisioning state of the lab.
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: The lab user list management profile.
props.name: rosterProfile

props.description: The AAD group ID which this lab roster is populated from. Having this set enables AAD sync mode.
props.name: activeDirectoryGroupId

props.description: The base URI identifying the lms instance.
props.name: lmsInstance

props.description: The unique id of the azure lab services tool in the lms.
props.name: ltiClientId

props.description: The unique context identifier for the lab in the lms.
props.name: ltiContextId

props.description: The uri of the names and roles service endpoint on the lms for the class attached to this lab.
props.name: ltiRosterEndpoint

props.description: The lab security profile.
props.name: securityProfile

props.description: Whether any user or only specified users can register to a lab.
props.name: openAccess

props.description: The registration code for the lab.
props.name: registrationCode

props.description: The lab state.
props.name: state

props.description: The title of the lab.
props.name: title

props.description: The profile used for creating lab virtual machines.
props.name: virtualMachineProfile

props.description: Additional VM capabilities.
props.name: additionalCapabilities

props.description: Flag to pre-install dedicated GPU drivers.
props.name: installGpuDrivers

props.description: Credentials for the admin user on the VM.
props.name: adminUser

props.description: The username to use when signing in to lab VMs.
props.name: username

props.description: Indicates what lab virtual machines are created from.
props.name: createOption

props.description: The image configuration for lab virtual machines.
props.name: imageReference

props.description: The actual version of the image after use.
props.name: exactVersion

props.description: Image resource ID
props.name: id

props.description: The image offer if applicable.
props.name: offer

props.description: The image publisher
props.name: publisher

props.description: The image SKU
props.name: sku

props.description: The image version specified on creation.
props.name: version

props.description: Credentials for the non-admin user on the VM, if one exists.
props.name: nonAdminUser

props.description: The OS type of the image
props.name: osType

props.description: The SKU for the lab. Defines the type of virtual machines used in the lab.
props.name: sku

props.description: If the SKU supports scale out/in then the capacity integer should be included. If scale out/in is not possible for the resource this may be omitted.
props.name: capacity

props.description: If the service has different generations of hardware, for the same SKU, then that can be captured here.
props.name: family

props.description: The name of the SKU. Ex - P3. It is typically a letter+number code
props.name: name

props.description: The SKU size. When the name field is the combination of tier and some other value, this would be the standalone code.
props.name: size

props.description: This field is required to be implemented by the Resource Provider if the service has more than one tier, but is not required on a PUT.
props.name: tier

props.description: The initial quota alloted to each lab user. Must be a time span between 0 and 9999 hours.
props.name: usageQuota

props.description: Enabling this option will use the same password for all user VMs.
props.name: useSharedPassword

props.description: Metadata pertaining to creation and last modification of the lab.
props.name: systemData

props.description: The timestamp of resource creation (UTC).
props.name: createdAt

props.description: The identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdBy

props.description: The type of identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdByType

props.description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
props.name: lastModifiedAt

props.description: The identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedBy

props.description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedByType

props.description: Resource tags.
props.name: tags

props.name: type
